PaletteAnimLists:
The colour animation lists: 80 pointers by animation id.

When: the record stepper (lib_animation: NextFrameRecord and CopyFrameData) reads a list step by step for actors with $24 = $0D (69 meta entries).
Sees: colours that rotate through a run of shades and fades of the backdrop colour; which scene effects these are was not traced.
Why: cycling a few palette entries is cheaper than redrawing tiles, so the animation is a list of colour blocks.
In: n/a (data): 80 words, index = animation id $1E; each points to 6-byte steps (hold, &source, destination colour, length - 1, delay) ending with a hold of 0.
Out: the source block (2 to 30 bytes, whole BGR555 colours, or 3 COLDATA bytes) is copied to $7F:offset (destination x 2); $26 = hold - 1, delay to $14 and $0E.
Clobbers: n/a (data).
WeaponOverlayAnims:
The animation list of the weapon sprite: 44 pointers.

When: the animator reads it for the weapon actor (RunWeaponLayer).
Sees: the blade or the staff drawn on top of the hero in every pose, thrust and swing.
Why: the weapon is a second sprite so it can be layered over or under the hero.
In: n/a (data): 44 words, index = animation id; each points to a list of 8-byte steps ending with $FFFF.
Out: the step and its frame leaf.
Clobbers: n/a (data).
